faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Jhajjar PTS-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the PTS-III post at AIIMS Jhajjar is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the PTS-III (Project Technical Support-III) position at AIIMS Jhajjar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online for this recruitment through the official AIIMS Jhajjar website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include BDS + MPH with 3 years post-graduation experience, BSC Nursing + MPH with 3 years experience, or a Post Graduation Degree in a relevant discipline with three years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the PTS-III post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the PTS-III position?
faq.answer: The salary for the PTS-III post will be as per ICMR Rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PTS-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PTS-III post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Jhajjar.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links for the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
